scope: Unidirectional k=1 m^-1 model cross-sections and dx-weighted Eulerian moments. Stokes expression valid only as weakly nonlinear expansion; no random-sea or hydrodynamic validation.
decision: Choppiness already changes Eulerian skewness. Adding a full second-order harmonic on top double-counts part of crest sharpening. Fit a common target under Eulerian measure before combining. A roller cannot be inferred from this single-valued surface: event onset, dissipated-energy allocation and multivalued immersion remain unresolved.
